items.title: Is A Medicare Delay The Biggest Risk For DexCom Stock?
items.summary: DexCom (DXCM) owners have one dated question left for 2026: will Medicare agree to pay for glucose monitors for people with type 2 diabetes who are not on insulin? DexCom said on its call after Q3 results that it expects CMS to announce that coverage decision this year, with DexCom's current plan assuming coverage takes effect in the middle of 2027. items.title: Is Abbott Laboratories (ABT) Undervalued On New Device And Test Launches?
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (ABT) has been back in focus after two health focused product milestones. The firm secured FDA and CE approvals for its UltiSynq defibrillation lead and launched the Panbio COVID-19/Flu A&B Self-Test in Canada. Despite a stream of new device approvals and test launches, Abbott Laboratories’ share price has slipped about 12% year to date. A 7.34% 1 month share price return suggests short term momentum is picking up, even as the 1 year total shareholder return is still down...
